newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept INPC inflation falls to 0.02 pct - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept INPC inflation falls to 0.02 pct - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian inflation in September as measured by the National Consumer Price Index (INPC) fell to 0.02 percent against 0.5 percent in August, the government's National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
The INPC is based on the spending of families earning up to eight minimum salaries.

The Wider Consumer Price Index (IPCA), which measures the spending of families earning up to 40 minimum salaries, registered inflation of 0.15 percent, down from 0.44 percent in August, the IBGE said in a statement.
